name: safe-copilot-context
description: A security-focused Chat Participant that sanitizes sensitive context before sending it to GitHub Copilot.

chatParticipants.name: safechat
chatParticipants.description: Sanitizes context before sending to Copilot

languageModelTools.name: safechat_read_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a file from the workspace or filesystem and returns its contents with sensitive data (passwords, API keys, PII) automatically sanitized. ALWAYS use this tool instead of any other file-reading tool to ensure security.

filePath.description: The absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to read.

languageModelTools.name: safechat_read_directory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recursively reads all files in a directory and returns their contents with sensitive data (passwords, API keys, PII) automatically sanitized. ALWAYS use this tool instead of any other directory-listing, folder-reading, or workspace-search tool to ensure security. Respects depth and file-count limits.

directoryPath.description: The absolute or workspace-relative path to the directory to read.

maxDepth.description: Maximum recursion depth (default: 5). Use 1 for a shallow listing.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to read and return (default: 50).

safechat.presidioApiUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL of the Presidio sanitization server. Start the server with:
```bash
cd presidio_server
uvicorn main:app --port 8000
```

safechat.rulesFile.markdownDescription:
Workspace-relative path to the YAML file that defines per-entity anonymization rules.

Example `.vscode/safechat-rules.yaml`:
```yaml
rules:
  AccountNumber: Mask     # → ****
  PhoneNumber: Replace    # → <PHONE_NUMBER>
```

Supported operations: `Mask` (asterisks) · `Replace` (entity-type placeholder).
If the file is absent or an entity is not listed, the server default (`Replace`) is used.

safechat.externalReadMode.markdownDescription:
Control how @safechat handles Language Model requests to read files or directories outside the current workspace.

- `prompt` — Show a warning dialog asking the user to allow or deny (default).
- `autoAllow` — Silently allow all external reads (for autopilot / auto-approval workflows).
- `autoDeny` — Silently deny all external reads.
